rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; the model says person.dc_earned omits Form 1040 line 1z components and statutory-employee Schedule C line 1. The amounts the model names are refused on every return the tool computes: Form 1040 lines 1b to 1d and 1f to 1h (household employee wages, tips not on a W-2, Medicaid waiver payments, adoption benefits, Form 8919 wages, other earned income) by scope.other_income (refused at f1040.line8 and scope.ready), statutory-employee and notary income by sc.statutory (sc.screened at sc.line1), and Schedule SE items outside the tool by person.se_screened. On the remaining returns line 1z is lines 1a and 1e, which person.dc_earned adds per person (amb.2025.dc_line1e_attribution) with net self-employment earnings. i2441 p. 4, Lines 4 and 5, earned income starts from "The amount shown on Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR, line 1z" and adds statutory-employee Schedule C line 1 and net self-employment earnings; p. 5, Line 18, "Earned income ... is determined in the same way as earned income for figuring the credit ... however, for purposes of lines 18 and 19, earned income doesn't include any dependent care benefits shown on line 12". Same ruling as the earlier rounds.

rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope/representation; i2441 (2025) p. 4 Lines 4 and 5 requires spouses to figure earned income separately; f1040 (2025) p. 1 line 1a takes W-2 box 1 and line 1z adds 1a-1h. scope.other_income excludes 1b-1d/1f-1h and is enforced at scope.ready/f1040.line8; statutory-employee/clergy cases are excluded by scope.schedule1, sc.statutory and person.se_screened. Thus the supported wage total is W-2 box 1 plus taxable dependent-care benefits (1e), allocated per the existing owner ruling amb.2025.dc_line1e_attribution (Stage 15 decision 6). person.dc_earned adds each person's wage share, that attribution and net SE earnings; dc_earned_b omits the benefits as i2441 p. 5 Line 18 requires. The refreshed prompt supplies Form 1040. The omitted wage classes are explicitly outside completed-return scope, not reviewer noise or supported cases.

rulings.model: CLW line 2 is 'Enter the amount from Schedule 3 (Form 1040), line 1 (foreign tax credit) and line 6l (Form 8978, line 14).' The restatement only enters s3 line 1 and omits Form 8978.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; i2441 (2025) p. 5 Line 10 Credit Limit Worksheet line 2 includes Schedule 3 lines 1 and 6l (Form 8978). scope.credits explicitly asks about Form 8978 adjustments and refuses them at s3.line8; scope.additional_tax also screens Form 8978 at f1040.line16. A supported completed return therefore has no Form 8978 amount and the worksheet reduces to s3.line1. This is an acknowledged scope reduction, not a claim that the IRS text omits line 6l.
